text.tspan: Veggie lovers rejoice! Our Veggie Delight cheesesteak features grilled
sliced mushrooms, crispy green peppers and savory onion grilled to
perfection and served on a toasted roll. We top our Veggie Delight with
smooth melted provolone, mellow shredded cheddar cheese, and sharp
Swiss to enhance the flavors of our featured veggies. This is the veggie
sandwich you’ve been waiting for. All cheesesteaks come with optional
creamy mayonnaise, juicy tomato, shredded lettuce, and crispy pickle.
The Veggie Delight pairs perfectly with Cheese Fries or an Original Real-
